alvo.foco: concordar com Me too e Me neither: I like singing. Me too (microphone, song, headphones, drum, piano, choir)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a concordar: depois de uma frase positiva use Me too; depois de uma negativa use Me neither.
falas: I like singing, Chloe.
Me too! I love this song.
Me too. I want to win.

alvo.gramatica: Show me… · Let me see… · Sign here
alvo.foco: pedidos no caixa: Show me, Let me see e Sign here (card, ID, receipt, pen, form, cash)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende pedidos simples numa compra: Show me your card, Let me see e Sign here.
alvo.obra_atual: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves
falas: Cassim, I want to buy this lamp. Show me your card, please.
Here is my card. Let me see the price first.
It’s twenty dollars. Sign here, please.

alvo.foco: dizer se algo é fácil ou difícil: easy, hard e difficult (puzzle, question, answer, game, test, lesson)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer se algo é fácil (easy) ou difícil (hard, difficult), com a expressão a piece of cake.
alvo.obra_atual: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
falas: Sam, this puzzle is easy. It’s a piece of cake!
Really? This question is hard for me.
Which question? Show me.

alvo.foco: comparar duas pessoas com both, the same e different: We both have a big smile (smile, hair, eyes, dresses, pizza, twins)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a comparar duas pessoas: both (as duas), the same (igual), different (diferente).
falas: Look, Annie! We both have a big smile.
And we have the same eyes.
But our hair is different.

alvo.foco: dizer um e-mail em voz alta: amelia at mail dot com (address, keyboard, name, airport, paper, suitcase)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer um e-mail: at (arroba), dot (ponto) e dash (traço). My email is amelia at mail dot com.
falas: Amelia, what is your email?
My email is amelia at mail dot com.
Is there a dash?

alvo.foco: falar de duração com It takes…: It takes two days to fix the rocket (rocket, planet, day, potato, radio, astronaut)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a falar de duração com It takes…: It takes two days to fix the rocket. How long does it take?
falas: Commander, the rocket is broken.
How long does it take to fix it?
It takes two days to fix the rocket.

alvo.foco: falar de aprendizado com learn, study e practice: I study German. I practice every day (accent, grammar, mistake, dictionary, notebook, teacher)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende learn (aprender), study (estudar) e practice (praticar). I study German grammar. I practice every day.
falas: Hendley, I learn German now.
Good. I study German grammar.
I practice with a strange accent.

alvo.foco: falar de rotina com often e rarely: I often study. I rarely check the clock (library, clock, lunch, teacher, bag, note)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende often (muitas vezes) e rarely (raramente): vêm antes do verbo. I often study here. I rarely check the clock.
falas: Bender, I often study in the library.
I rarely check the clock.
Really? I often check it. It is eight.

alvo.foco: pedir para não fazer algo com Please don’t + verbo: Please don’t open the gift (gift, tree, candy, sleigh, Santa, snow)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a pedir para não fazer algo: Please don’t + verbo. Please don’t open the gift. Please don’t touch the tree.
falas: Jovie, please don’t open the gift.
Okay. Please don’t touch the tree, Buddy.
Sorry! Please don’t eat all the candy.

alvo.foco: dizer que acabou com not any e no (fridge, shelf, empty, cheese, jam, bread)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer que não há nada: There isn’t any… ou There is no… (mesma ideia, dois jeitos).
falas: Dad, I’m hungry. Is there any cheese?
Let me look. No, there isn’t any cheese.
Is there any jam on the shelf?

alvo.gramatica: a roll of · a stick of · a bar of
alvo.foco: pedir um item pela embalagem: a roll of, a stick of, a bar of (soap, gum, chocolate, tape, paper towels)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a pedir pela forma do produto: a roll of (rolo), a stick of (palito/tablete) e a bar of (barra).
falas: Excuse me. I need a roll of tape.
Sure. It’s on the second shelf.
Thanks. And a bar of soap, please.

alvo.foco: descrever o trajeto: along the river, at the end of the road (boat, river, trees, village, road, lake)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende along (ao longo de) e at the end of (no fim de). The boat goes along the river. The lake is at the end of the river.
falas: Rose, the boat goes along the river.
Yes, Charlie. We walk along the river, too.
Look! The trees are along the bank.

alvo.gramatica: The next stop is… · get on · get off
alvo.foco: andar de ônibus com the next stop, get on e get off (bus, stop, seat, bell, passenger, route)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a andar de ônibus: The next stop is…, get on (subir) e get off (descer).
falas: Good morning! Please get on the bus.
Good morning! Does this bus go to the park?
Yes. Take a seat, please.

alvo.foco: dizer o que é obrigatório e proibido com must e mustn’t (parking, meter, fine, space, sign, rule)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer regras: must (é preciso) e mustn’t (é proibido).
falas: Excuse me, sir. You mustn’t park here.
Why not? There is a free space.
It is a no-parking zone. Look at the sign.

alvo.foco: perguntar o que é permitido com allowed e not allowed: Are we allowed on the ice (ice, tree, cave, snow, mammoth, baby)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende allowed (permitido) e not allowed (não permitido). Are we allowed on the ice? You are not allowed on the tree.
falas: Manny, are we allowed on the ice?
No, Sid. You are not allowed on the tree.
Then where are we allowed?

alvo.gramatica: pass a test · fail a test
alvo.foco: falar de provas com pass a test e fail a test (test, grade, result, notes, proud, study)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a falar de provas: Topanga, I pass the test! I got a good grade. Look! The result is here. Mr. Feeny is happy.
falas: Topanga, I pass the test!
Wow! What is the grade?
I got a good grade. Look!

alvo.foco: mover arquivos com download e upload (file, folder, photo, app, wifi, storage)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a mover arquivos: I download the file. Save it in a folder. I upload a photo of the team.
falas: I download the file.
Save it in a folder.
I upload a photo of the team.

alvo.foco: fazer o check-in com check in e boarding pass (check in, suitcase, boarding pass, window seat, flight, counter)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a fazer check-in no aeroporto: Hello! I want to check in, please. Put your suitcase here. Yes. Here is your boarding pass.
falas: Good morning! Go to the check-in counter.
Hello! I want to check in, please.
Put your suitcase here.

alvo.foco: apresentar o time com team, player e fan (team, player, fan, captain, jersey, number)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende as pessoas do esporte: team (time), player (jogador) e fan (torcedor).
falas: Hello! I am a reporter. May I ask you something?
Sure! I am a player on the Eagles.
What is your jersey number?

alvo.gramatica: in the lead · behind · catch up
alvo.foco: narrar posições com in the lead, behind e catch up (lead, crowd, trophy, rival, sprint, hill)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a narrar a disputa: Muttley, I am in the lead! The crowd cheers for you, boss. I want the trophy!
falas: Muttley, I am in the lead!
The crowd cheers for you, boss.
I want the trophy!
